summary: Completed public UI and integration testing for MILLO storefront on desktop and mobile. Homepage, imagery, product selectors, detail modal, cart, quantity updates, checkout validation, non-zero order confirmation, combo, FAQ, and mobile overflow checks passed.

ui_bugs.issue: Hamburger button is clickable but has no handler and does not reveal navigation links; mobile users cannot access Shop, Combos, or Our story from the nav.

action_items: Implement a mobile navigation menu or remove/disable the hamburger until it has functional behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: Checkout is intentionally a LOCAL ORDER-INTENT PROTOTYPE: no payment API or backend persistence is connected, as requested.
Footer links and some footer interactive elements lack data-testid attributes despite the stated testability requirement.

success_rate.backend: N/A (mocked/local checkout; no backend API exercised)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Recheck mobile hamburger navigation after implementation. Core checkout total regression passed: one 60g item plus quantity increase confirmed ₹118, and modal 60g flow confirmed ₹59.
rca of the issue: App.js renders mobile-menu-button without state or onClick behavior, while CSS hides .nav-links under 800px. Consequently the only mobile navigation affordance cannot expose the hidden links.
